messages.subject: Mentor Summit
parts:
Dear mentors,

We are allowed to send two representatives to the Mentor Summit among the mentors that have participated in GSoC
with our organisation. The summit will take place on Saturday and Sunday, 20 & 21 October
at Google's Mountain View, California, USA Headquarters.

Please let me (or any of the other admins) know if you are interested as soon as possible.

Best,

Virgilio
